title: Sentiment-padding carve-out — interpersonal reaction (keep) vs. own-mood-with-named-cause (drop)
notes: Pins the exact behavior the WS3 LoCoMo prompt fix (astramemory-local#269) targets: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CONVERSATIONAL's 'sentiment padding' banned-abstraction was rewritten so the operative test is WHOSE LIFE a reaction is about, not whether a cause is named. This fixture is the reviewer-requested persisted regression coverage for that boundary (05-extract.test.ts mocks the LLM so it can't test instruction-following; this fixture, run live via run-bench.mts --fixtures-dir scripts/eval/extraction-bench/fixtures-conversational --extract-profile conversational, actually exercises it). Three cases in one short conversation: (1) Priya's notice + Sergey's reaction to it — a reaction to ANOTHER named person's specific stated event — MUST be kept as its own atom (both atoms are in gold_atoms). (2) 'just been an ordinary week' — vague filler, no durable content — correctly yields nothing. (3) Sergey frustrated with 'this build' — HIS OWN mood, WITH a named cause ('the build') — deliberately EXCLUDED from gold_atoms: this is the exact case an earlier draft of the fix got wrong (the rule read as 'skip a mood with no named cause', which a model could reasonably read as 'any mood WITH a named cause survives' — see astramemory-local#269 review). Extracting an atom for case (3) is the regression this fixture exists to catch; the judge's precision score (not just recall) is the signal — a broken prompt keeps the same 2 gold atoms (recall unaffected) but ALSO extracts the build-frustration atom (precision drops).

turns.text: Pretty good! Priya finally handed in her notice at her old job today — she's been wanting to make this move for months.
Whoa, that's huge! How do you feel about it?
Really proud of her, honestly. Otherwise it's just been an ordinary week I guess. Ugh, I'm also super frustrated with this build though, it's been failing all afternoon for no clear reason.

gold_atoms.text: Priya handed in her notice at her old job, after wanting to make this move for months.
Sergey is proud of Priya for handing in her notice at her old job.
